prereqs: CNCjs running (npm install -g cncjs) and connected to a GRBL controller by USB. Clone the repo and build it (npm install && npm run build). SAFETY: this can move a real machine. Keep an operator at the E-stop, dry-run with the spindle off and Z raised, and never let students run AI-generated G-code without teacher review.
claude_code_command: claude mcp add cncjs-mcp --env CNCJS_URL=http://localhost:8000 -- node /path/to/CNC-design-control-MCP/build/index.js
